name: tag
title: Tag
description: A small label for category or status — ghost, filled, or outlined. Metadata, not interactive filters.

discovery.name: Tag
discovery.description: A small label for category or status — ghost, filled, or outlined. Metadata, not interactive filters.

configurables.what: Surface treatment of the status tag.
configurables.how: filled for primary status; outlined for quiet meta; ghost for inline. Default: filled.
neutral for meta; success/warning/danger for state; brand/ai sparingly. Default: neutral.
s default; xs for dense tables; m for marketing. Default: s.
true for live/status lists; false for pure labels. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Tags are not interactive by default — do not use them as buttons; use Chip or Button.

agent.usage:
import { Tag } from '@/components/atoms/Tag';

<Tag variant="filled" intent="success" size="s">
  Live
</Tag>
